fields.name: token
fields.label: API token
fields.note: Create a token in the target project's Security → API tokens page. Choose Read to inspect resources or Read & Write to manage them.

config.hint: Use HCLOUD_TOKEN with the hcloud CLI or as a Bearer token for the Hetzner Cloud API at https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1. Access is limited to the project and permissions selected when the token was created.
